g2_inheritance.rationale: G2 的 status PASS 是执行记录；其预注册合规性为 FAIL（HC3 0.999 在 as-run 口径下不可达，且存在最终测试距离进入开发等偏离）。两行必须分开陈述。

frozen_evidence_protection.method: recomputed whole-tree digest (path + sha256 per file) against the pre-change snapshot

tests.basetemp_note: The default temp dir is refused at teardown by the host's bulk-delete guard (~478 files), which rewrites the process exit code to 1 while the JUnit still records 425 passed. --basetemp points at an empty directory inside the project so the run reaches a self-consistent exit 0. Exposing that arrangement revealed a real test defect, fixed in this round: test_path_outside_the_project_is_refused borrowed tmp_path as an 'outside' path, so it silently stopped testing anything once the temp dir moved inside ROOT.
tests.wall_s_note: JUnit's own `time` attribute. pytest's summary line prints the same value as `145.55s` because it formats with two decimals; neither is a separate measurement.

serve_smoke.measured_limit: An HTTP-only probe cannot detect a page that fails to import. Measured: pointing streamlit run at a file with a broken import leaves /_stcore/health answering 'ok', / serving the shell, and the log clean, because Streamlit executes the script only when a websocket session attaches. Enabling --server.scriptHealthCheckEnabled does not change this either (measured). Import errors are therefore covered by AppTest in tests/ui/, which executes the script and surfaces ModuleNotFoundError as at.exception (asserted).
serve_smoke.healthz_is_not_health: /healthz returns the 6467-byte SPA shell, byte-identical to /, so a probe against it would pass even with a sick runtime.

reports.pdf_reason: no PDF renderer installed (reportlab / weasyprint / fpdf all absent); no empty file is produced

audit_package.csv_truncation: none (PRE-G3-04 repaired: ship whole or exclude with full-file hash)
audit_package.zip_sha256_note: a ZIP cannot contain its own hash, and this status file is inside the ZIP; the authoritative value is written outside the archive to AUDIT_ZIP_SHA256.txt next to it.  Recording it here would create a self-reference that changes every time this file is edited.
audit_package.bytes_note: the byte size (and the SHA-256) cannot be recorded inside the package: this status file is itself a member, so writing its own archive size changes that size.  Both values are authoritative in AUDIT_ZIP_SHA256.txt beside the ZIP.
audit_package.members_untehashed_reason: These two members cannot hash themselves, so they are outside the manifest by construction; the verifier checks them by parsing and by comparing SHA256SUMS.txt against every other member, rather than by a hash recorded inside them.
audit_package.manifest_coverage_rule: verify_g3_audit_package.py requires every member except manifest.json and SHA256SUMS.txt to appear in the manifest; those two are excluded because a file cannot contain the hash of itself.
audit_package.member_counts_note: The member count is NOT recorded here. This file sits inside the archive, so writing the count would change the archive and invalidate the count - the same self-reference that makes bytes/zip_sha256 null. The authoritative counts are printed by scripts/build_g3_audit_package.py and re-derived by scripts/verify_g3_audit_package.py at verification time.
